verdict.rationale: A machine channel is a fair question for an IP office, but nothing in the pack documents one for transacting. The docs cover web-based filing for trademarks, patents, designs and e-Soleau, with no API, system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers or published enrollment path. The only machine-access item is a probe showing a 403 on the open-data portal. That bears on reading IP data, not on transacting, and it documents no enrollment process.
